mainEntity.name: How long does an exterior restoration project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior restoration project varies significantly based on the size of the building, the extent of damage, and weather conditions. A smaller project might take a few weeks, while a larger, more complex restoration could take several months. Factors like the need for specialized materials or unexpected discoveries during demolition can also influence the timeline, so detailed project planning is essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies based on building size, damage extent, and weather, ranging from weeks to months. Specialized materials or unexpected issues can also affect the timeline.
